heard: Next to Uziel the goldsmith stood A perfumer with hands that could build In the city of Jerusalem they worked side by side Restored the stone as far as the broad wall No one asked for glory or fame Just the task at hand in the dust Shoulder to shoulder in the rain Ananias son of Uziel Building the wall with steady hand Next to him a perfumer stood Adding their part to the plan Gaps were closed, the work went on Under the sun
